newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Keppel FELS falls to new year low.
newsitem.headline: Keppel FELS falls to new year low.

text.p: Keppel FELS, the shipyard unit of Keppel Corp, slumped to a new year low of Singapore $4.98 on Wednesday, falling S$0.17 in early trade after the company said its 1997 outlook was weak, dealers said.
"It is pretty bad and the news may be taking some time to filter through," said a dealer with a local brokerage.
Keppel FELS announced results for the year to December 31, 1996 of S$54.36 million, up 18.1 percent, but said it expected 1997 results to be substantially lower.
"Quite possibly the fall is the reaction from European and U.S. investors selling," the dealer added.
